attempts.summary: Implemented a password complexity policy on node1 (pam_pwquality minlen=12, minclass=3) using an Ansible playbook run from node2 (the control node with ansible installed). Functionally verified weak-password rejection and compliant-password acceptance, then executed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on both node1 and node2, confirming changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery.
